eyebrow: UNION / UNION ALL — no surprises anywhere
code:
-- Identical on T-SQL, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL
SELECT CustomerID FROM ActiveCustomers
UNION
SELECT CustomerID FROM ArchivedCustomers;
caption: No dialect quirks at all — this one is fully portable.

code:
-- T-SQL, Oracle, MySQL 8.0.31+, PostgreSQL
SELECT CustomerID FROM OnlineOrders
INTERSECT
SELECT CustomerID FROM StoreOrders;
caption: Rows present in BOTH queries — consistent everywhere.

code:
-- T-SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL 8.0.31+
SELECT CustomerID FROM AllCustomers
EXCEPT
SELECT CustomerID FROM ArchivedCustomers;

-- Oracle — same semantics, different name

caption: Three platforms converged on EXCEPT; Oracle alone kept MINUS.
